name: ChurchTools
shortDescription: A European church management platform with person-based packages, a 30-day trial, German hosting and service-planning tools.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a European-hosted church administration and planning platform

pricing.summary: Published euro and US-dollar packages vary by people, campuses, resources and ministry roles.

startingPrice.qualifier: XS package for up to 100 people; listed service prices exclude VAT

dataHosting: The supplier states that hosted accounts are hosted in Germany.
gdprInformation: The pricing page describes German hosting as GDPR-related; this directory has not independently assessed compliance.
support: Group training calls during the trial

editorial.assessment: ChurchTools adds a European-hosted option to the foundation set and publishes package limits clearly. UK churches still need to verify Gift Aid, sterling payments, support fit and UK regulatory requirements.
bestFor: Churches that value European hosting information
Teams combining member administration with service planning
strengths: Package limits and prices are publicly listed
The supplier states that hosting is in Germany
limitations: No UK-specific Gift Aid support has been confirmed
Published entry pricing is in euros rather than pounds sterling

seo.title: ChurchTools: UK church software profile
seo.description: Independent ChurchTools profile covering pricing, German hosting, trial and service planning, with UK-specific unknowns made explicit.
